name: Memory — hermes_context topic search
mechanical_verification: Store 3 memories with different topics, query with one topic, verify only relevant memories returned
prompt: call hermes_remember topic=project-auth value="auth module uses bcrypt" && call hermes_remember topic=project-db value="postgresql connection pooling" && call hermes_remember topic=project-api value="REST endpoints on port 3000"

verification_steps.expected: Returns auth, db, and api memories (all matching 'project' prefix)
verification_steps.mechanical_pass: Response contains at least 2 of the 3 stored memories

verification_steps.expected: Returns empty or no results (not an error)
verification_steps.mechanical_pass: No crash, no error, graceful empty response

pass_criteria.no_crash: hermes_context handles empty result without error

failure_modes.returns_all: Returns ALL memories ignoring topic filter
failure_modes.crashes: Empty topic query causes crash or exception
